content.text:
Both findings were narrow and localized; I applied the report's fixes exactly and changed nothing else.

**Finding 1 — FIG. 3 drive face position.** The final geometry bullet in `figures/FIG-3.md` verbalized a circumferential relationship (clear of the three slots and of the junction end faces) for reference numeral 54, a functional drive surface with no positional support in the disclosure. Replaced with a relationship-free statement that marks the outline and position as a depiction convention. The numeral placement target for 54 already read "the short plain drive face on the band" and needed no change, so the brief stays synchronized with the numeral table and the drawing description. No description, drawings-list, or claim text was added to justify the drawn location.

**Finding 2 — carriage spring number.** Claim 1's "a carriage spring biasing each jaw carriage" read literally as one spring serving all three carriages, while claim 9 ("the carriage spring of each jaw carriage") and claim 16 ("a respective carriage spring") presuppose one per carriage, as does the description ("the carriage springs 42") and the disclosure ("A spring biases each carriage outward"). Amended claim 1 to "a respective carriage spring"; claims 9 and 16 and the description are unchanged and now have clean antecedent basis.

No other section was touched — the numeral table, detailed description, drawings list, abstract, and the other four figure briefs are byte-for-byte as approved. The rendered sheets are not edited directly; FIG. 3 will re-render from the corrected brief and re-inspect on the next pipeline pass.

One thing to note from the drafting brief: no prior-art search was run for this application, so the art in `prior_art/` may be incomplete. The gate report's source-fidelity trace covers support in the inventor's disclosure, not novelty over uncited art, and the Background's characterizations of existing clamps were deferred to a separate prior-art trace.

The numeral target "54: the short plain drive face on the band." is retained unchanged, so the brief remains synchronized with the numeral table and the Brief Description of the Drawings; nothing was added to the description or claims to justify the drawn location. (2) draft/09-claims.md: claim 1's fourth element is amended from "a carriage spring biasing each jaw carriage outward from the central axis;" to "a respective carriage spring biasing each jaw carriage outward from the central axis;", curing the number mismatch with claim 9 ("the carriage spring of each jaw carriage") and claim 16 ("a respective carriage spring") and giving claim 9 clean antecedent basis. Claims 9 and 16, the detailed description ("the carriage springs 42"), the numeral table, and the other four figure briefs are unchanged. No claim scope, embodiment, or disclosed structure was altered; no rendered artifact was edited, so FIG. 3 re-renders and re-inspects from the corrected brief. Note for the record, per the drafting brief: no prior-art search was run, so the art supplied in prior_art/ may be incomplete, and the Background's prior-art characterizations were deferred by the gate to a separate prior-art trace.

patches.replace: - A short plain drive face on the band. The drive face is shown schematically; its outline and its position on the band are a depiction convention and are not stated to bear any relationship to the slot outlines or to the junction end faces.
patches.why: Gate finding: the bullet verbalized a circumferential position for the ring drive face 54 relative to the oblique slots and the segment junction end faces. The replacement keeps the face and its identifying numeral while removing the unsupported positional relationship.
